title: Windows clean install and launch
journey: Per-user path avoids unexpected elevation; identity/location are deterministic; desktop/client payload and Qt runtime are complete; entrypoint launches; IPC is user-scoped; startup is consent-controlled.

platform.desktop_session: required for graphical desktop journeys; otherwise not applicable

preconditions: Disposable dedicated acceptance identity and scenario-owned state.
No prior Synveil installation, package registration, installer-owned integration or stale acceptance state unless a declared upgrade/recovery source is required.
A brand-new OS and removal of unrelated user files are not required.

steps.description: Obtain and identify the required artifact.
Open through the supported native graphical surface.
Make explicit product options and consent choices.
Install using the contracted platform authority.
Launch through the supported installed entrypoint.

assertions.description: Complete the ordinary GUI journey without terminal input or manual ZIP extraction.
Per-user installation completes without administrator elevation.
Installed Start Menu/desktop entrypoint launches the installed desktop application.
Desktop control uses the existing local, user-scoped IPC boundary.
Report complete only after desktop and client executables, Qt runtime, platform integration and launch path are verified.
Client executable is present in the installed payload.
Required Qt runtime libraries and QML modules are present beside the installed product.
Installed application and client payload exist at the deterministic per-user product location.

forbidden_outcomes.description: Installer lifecycle deletes user library content.
Credential value is written to ordinary config or diagnostics.
Unknown or newer schema is reset or downgraded.
Persistent startup is enabled without explicit user consent.
Desktop control is exposed through a public TCP/HTTP listener.
An ambiguous mutation is blindly replayed without authoritative reconciliation.
Installation is reported complete before payload, integration and launch verification.
Ordinary Windows journey requires manual ZIP extraction.
